name: AP_OTHER_PERIODS_
description: AP_OTHER_PERIODS contains information about the time periods you define for use in recurring invoices, withholding taxes, key indicators and payment terms. AP_OTHER_PERIODS_ is the audit table for AP_OTHER_PERIODS.

columns.description: Identifier of the application in the period set up.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period used for withholding tax calculation or payment terms.

columns.name: CALENDAR_TYPE
